about: More distributions for Try Linux (Windows). Each entry is found and checked the same way as the built-in ones: 'base' is an official mirror folder, each step is added to it (a step starting with ~ is a regex matched against the folder's links, newest first), and 'checksum' names the official checksum file next to the ISO ({iso} is the ISO's file name; a leading ~ is a regex). SHA-256 and SHA-512 checksums are both checked. Only https mirrors are used.
